Domestic water, roof leaders and condensate drains

modules.author: Personal library

modules.name: Data center program milestones — design through ready for service
modules.desc: Level 1 program skeleton for a data hall: design, permitting, early site package, shell and core, MEP fit-out overlapped with shell, commissioning L3 to L5 and turnover, with utility power availability as a hard gate on energization and commissioning. Defaults follow published phase ranges (design 6-12 months, permitting 6-18, shell 3-9, MEP 6-12, Cx 3-6).

queries.prompt: Permitting (site plan, building, generator air permit)
Utility service available, weeks from start

tasks.desc: Permits: site plan, building, generator air permit
Early site package: clearing, grading, underground
MEP fit-out (starts 16 weeks after shell start)
Utility service available (gate for permanent power)
Commissioning L3 to L5 on permanent power

modules.author: Personal library

modules.name: Long-lead equipment — submittals, release, fabrication, FAT and delivery
modules.desc: Procurement tracker for the critical-path equipment: submittal approval and release, then manufacture, witnessed FAT and delivery for each family in parallel, with a part-time expediter. Default lead times follow 2025-26 market data (large power transformers 90-130+ weeks, gensets over 3 MW 90-110, MV switchgear about 44, UPS 30-48, chillers 40-70, CDUs 26-52, busway 16-52). Link each delivery to its install module.

tasks.desc: Main power transformers: manufacture, FAT, deliver
UPS and batteries: manufacture, FAT, deliver
Chillers / dry coolers: manufacture, FAT, deliver
Expediting, FAT witness trips and delivery coordination

modules.author: Personal library

modules.name: Live data center work — MOPs, change control and maintenance windows
modules.desc: Work in or next to an operating data hall: as-found survey, written Method of Procedure for each critical activity (steps, hold points, rollback), owner change-control review finalized at least two weeks ahead, rehearsal and walkdown, execution in approved windows under the two-person rule, then post-work verification and closeout.

tasks.desc: Write MOPs: steps, hold points, rollback, contacts
Owner change-control review and approval (2 weeks minimum)
Execute in approved windows (two qualified people)
Post-work verification, as-builts and MOP closeout

modules.author: Personal library

modules.name: Pre-commissioning cleaning — ISO 14644-1 Class 8 white space
modules.desc: Critical-environment cleaning before IT install: construction clean and debris removal, overhead wipe-down of tray, busway and grid, under-floor plenum HEPA vacuum where there is a raised floor, final HEPA floor clean with tack mats at entries, then particle counts to verify ISO 14644-1 Class 8.

tasks.desc: Overhead wipe-down: tray, busway, grid, containment
Under-floor plenum HEPA vacuum and wipe
Final HEPA floor clean, tack mats and protection protocol
Particle counts to ISO 14644-1 Class 8 and sign-off

modules.author: Personal library

modules.name: Customer HV substation (115-230 kV) and utility interconnection
modules.desc: Owner-built high-voltage substation for a campus: interconnection and relay-settings coordination with the utility, yard grading, stone and oil containment, ground grid, foundations, steel and bus, breakers and switches, main power transformers dressed and oil-processed, control house with relays and SCADA, control wiring, acceptance tests, then utility witness, backfeed and energization. New substations commonly take 3-5 years end to end; the yard build itself is about 12-14 months.

tasks.desc: Interconnection design review and relay-settings coordination
Yard grading, stone surfacing and oil containment
Ground grid, risers and grid resistance test
Foundations: transformer pads, structure piers, control house
Set breakers, switches, CTs / PTs and arresters
Set main power transformers; oil fill, vacuum and dry-out
Control house, relay panels, RTU / SCADA and DC batteries
Acceptance tests: TTR, power factor, SFRA, breaker timing, relay functionals

modules.author: Personal library

modules.name: Perimeter security — anti-climb fence, crash-rated gates and bollards
modules.desc: Campus perimeter hardening: layout, post holes and concrete, anti-climb 358 mesh panels, crash-rated gate foundations and gates with operators (ASTM F2656 M30 / M50), shallow-mount crash bollards, and tie-in of gates to access control, intercom and CCTV.

tasks.desc: Post holes and concrete (posts at about 8 ft)
Gate access control, intercom and CCTV tie-in
Final inspection and gate cycle tests

modules.author: Personal library

modules.name: Outside plant fiber — HDD conduit, handholes and diverse carrier entrances
modules.desc: Diverse long-haul and carrier fiber into the meet-me rooms: locates, potholing and permits, directional bores with conduit bundles (300-1,000 ft per day; clay 600-700, cobble about 100), handholes and vaults, building entrance duct and seals, cable pulls, ribbon fusion splicing at the entrance facility, bidirectional OTDR and carrier cross-connects.

tasks.desc: Locates, potholing, permits and bore plans
Directional bores: pilot, ream and pull back conduit bundle
Building entrance duct bank, seals and grounding
Ribbon fusion splicing at the entrance facility
Bidirectional OTDR, loss tests and documentation

modules.author: Personal library

modules.name: Site paving, roads and stormwater detention
modules.desc: Campus roads, truck courts and parking with stormwater: subgrade preparation, aggregate base, storm pipe and inlets, detention pond excavation and outlet structure, curb and gutter, asphalt paving, striping and signage.

tasks.desc: Detention pond excavation and outlet structure

modules.author: Personal library

modules.name: Fire water — fire pump, storage tank and underground fire loop
modules.desc: Site fire water supply where the municipal main is not enough: tank foundation, erected steel storage tank, fire pump skid or pump house with controller and transfer switch, underground fire loop, hydrants and PIVs, hydrostatic test at 200 psi for 2 hours and flush, then the NFPA 20 fire pump acceptance test.

tasks.desc: Erect steel storage tank and test
Fire pump skid / house set, suction and discharge piping
Underground fire main and thrust blocks
Pump power, controller and transfer switch
Hydrostatic test 200 psi for 2 h and flush
NFPA 20 fire pump acceptance test with AHJ

modules.name: NETA acceptance testing — switchgear, breakers, relays, transformers and MV cable
modules.desc: ANSI/NETA ATS acceptance testing before energization (supports Cx Level 2-3): test plan and settings files, MV switchgear and breakers (insulation resistance, contact resistance, timing, withstand), LV power breakers by primary injection, protective relays by secondary injection with settings loaded, transformers (TTR, insulation, power factor, winding resistance), MV cable VLF withstand (60 minutes recommended) with tan delta, ground-fault performance tests, then reports and retests.

tasks.desc: Test plan, settings files and equipment readiness
LV power circuit breakers, primary injection
Protective relays: secondary injection, settings, trip checks
Transformers: TTR, insulation, power factor, winding resistance
MV cable VLF withstand and tan delta

modules.author: Personal library

modules.name: Short-circuit, coordination and arc-flash study, settings and labels
modules.desc: Power system studies for energization: field data collection, model build, short-circuit and equipment duty, protective device coordination (TCCs), IEEE 1584-2018 incident energy with mitigation (maintenance switches, faster clearing), review with the engineer of record, setting the adjustable devices, and machine-printed NFPA 70E 130.5(H) labels at every work location.

tasks.desc: Field data collection and nameplate verification
Model build, short-circuit and equipment duty
Review with engineer of record and owner

modules.author: Personal library

modules.name: Generator acceptance — NFPA 110 on-site test and load bank
modules.desc: Standby generator acceptance after vendor start-up: pre-start inspection, fuel fill and tank leak test, building-load test of at least 1.5 hours with cold start and transfer, the 2-hour resistive load-bank test (30% for 30 minutes, 50% for 30 minutes, 100% for 60 minutes) on each unit, paralleling and load-share tests where fitted, and reports.

tasks.desc: Pre-start inspection: fluids, batteries, heaters, rotation
Fuel fill and tank / piping leak test
Building-load test, at least 1.5 h with cold start and transfer

modules.author: Personal library

modules.name: UPS battery acceptance and capacity testing (IEEE 450 / 1188)
modules.desc: Battery acceptance before Level 4: inspect and torque intercell connections with IR scan, 72 hours on float, ohmic baseline of every cell or module, a capacity discharge at the UPS 5-15 minute rate on each string with a load bank (pass at 100% or better at acceptance), then recharge, retest any failures and report.

tasks.desc: Float charge 72 hours before the test
Ohmic baseline of every jar / module
Capacity discharge test at the UPS rate (each string)
Recharge, retest failures and replace jars

modules.author: Personal library

modules.name: Prefabricated power skid or eHouse — receive, set and hook-up
modules.desc: Factory-built power modules (eHouse, power skid, prefabricated UPS room): pier and embed survey, receive and offload, set and align each shipping split, splice bus and inter-section joints, anchor and seal roof joints, terminate external feeders and controls, ground and hook up HVAC and fire systems, and reduced field testing after the witnessed FAT. Published schedule savings run about 30%, up to 50% when pre-engineered.

tasks.desc: Pier / embed survey and foundation check
Anchor, weld out and seal roof joints
Grounding, HVAC and fire system hook-up

modules.author: Personal library

modules.name: Bridge / on-site gas power — reciprocating engine plant
modules.desc: Behind-the-meter power while the utility service is built: foundations, gas lateral with metering and regulation, set the engine gensets and auxiliary modules, mechanical balance of plant (radiators, lube oil, exhaust and SCR), MV collector switchgear and step-up, plant controls and microgrid, then start-up, emissions and reliability run. Market range 2.5-35 MW per site at about $1,700-2,000 per kW, 12-24 months.

tasks.desc: Gas lateral, metering and regulation station
Mechanical BOP: radiators, lube oil, exhaust and SCR
MV collector switchgear, step-up and cabling
Plant controls, SCADA and microgrid integration
Start-up, emissions test and reliability run

modules.author: Personal library

modules.name: Battery energy storage system (BESS) — containerized
modules.desc: Containerized BESS for ride-through, peak shaving or bridge power: foundations, set containers and power conversion, DC and AC cabling and terminations, MV transformer tie-in, fire detection, deflagration venting and auxiliary power, then commissioning and EMS integration.

tasks.desc: Fire detection, deflagration venting and auxiliary power

modules.author: Personal library

modules.name: Liquid cooling — TCS hydrotest, staged flush, fill and water-quality release
modules.desc: Pre-commission preparation of the technology cooling system per OCP guidance: hydrostatic test at 1.3-1.5x working pressure, temporary jumpers and bypasses at the rack connections, staged filtration flush (100 micron stepping down to 5) with at least 4 hours of circulation on every leg, drain and rinse until turbidity is below 5 NTU with lab samples, fill with the specified coolant within 24 hours of the final flush (nitrogen purge if longer), then CDU start-up and water-quality release before any IT is connected.

tasks.desc: Temporary flush jumpers and bypasses at rack connections
Staged filtration flush, at least 4 h circulation per leg
Drain and DI rinse to below 5 NTU; lab samples
Fill with coolant within 24 h; vent air
Remove jumpers, CDU start-up and water-quality release

modules.author: Personal library

modules.name: Rear-door heat exchangers — install, connect and commission
modules.desc: Rack-level cooling for higher density without containment changes: branch piping and valves from a CDU secondary loop, remove rear doors and fit hinges and RDHx doors, route hoses with quick-disconnects, fill, vent and leak check, power and sensors for active doors, then commission flow, temperatures and the supply temperature above dew point.

tasks.desc: Branch piping, isolation and balancing valves
Remove rear doors; fit hinges and RDHx doors
Power, controls and temperature sensors (active doors)

modules.author: Personal library

modules.name: Immersion cooling — tanks, CDUs, piping and dielectric fill
modules.desc: Single-phase immersion deployment: floor-load check and layout, set tanks and CDUs (about one to four 100 kW tanks per 200-240 kW CDU), facility water to the CDUs, tank-to-CDU piping and leak test, A / B power and sensors, dielectric fluid fill and filtration, then commissioning and BMS integration of fill levels and temperatures.

tasks.desc: Floor-load check, layout and drip containment
A / B power feeds and sensors

modules.author: Personal library

modules.name: Cooling towers and condenser water — water-cooled plant
modules.desc: Heat rejection for water-cooled chiller plants: tower basins and foundations, set or field-erect tower cells, condenser water pumps and strainers, condenser water piping, fan motors, VFDs and basin heaters, water treatment with chemical feed and blowdown, then fill, flush, start-up and vibration checks.

tasks.desc: Fan motors, VFDs and basin heaters
Water treatment, chemical feed and blowdown
Fill, flush, start-up and vibration checks

modules.name: Hydronic cleaning, water treatment and test-and-balance
modules.desc: Chilled and facility water loops after installation: chemical pre-clean with temporary strainers, drain and flush to clear, passivation and inhibitor dosing with lab sign-off, side-stream filter and chemical feed set-up, hydronic balancing of pumps, coils and balancing valves, air balancing of CRAHs or fan walls with containment pressure, and the TAB report for commissioning.

queries.prompt: Coils and heat exchangers (CRAH, fan wall, CDU)

tasks.desc: Chemical pre-clean and circulation with temporary strainers
Drain, flush to clear and remove temporary strainers
Passivation, inhibitor dosing and lab sign-off
Side-stream filter and chemical feed set-up
Hydronic balancing: pumps, coils, balancing valves
Air balancing of CRAHs / fan walls and containment pressure

modules.name: AI / GPU high-density racks — receive, move, set and connect (NVL72 class)
modules.desc: Deployment of 120-140 kW liquid-cooled AI racks weighing about 1.36-1.47 t each: route survey of dock, ramps and floor loading (250-350 psf), floor protection and load-spreading plates, receive and inspect tilt and shock indicators, move with air skates or a rack mover and set, level, anchor and bond, connect power (several feeds per rack), connect liquid-cooling hoses and leak check, patch network fiber, and support vendor power-on and burn-in.

tasks.desc: Route survey: dock, ramps, elevator and floor loading
Receive, unpack and inspect tilt / shock indicators
Move with air skates / rack mover and set
Connect liquid-cooling hoses and leak check

modules.name: Leak detection — sensing cable, point sensors and BMS alarms
modules.desc: Leak detection for liquid-cooled halls and plant: layout along leak paths and low points (CDUs, manifolds, quick-disconnects, under TCS piping), controllers and power, sensing cable with leader cables and terminators, point sensors in drip trays and CDU pans, BMS / DCIM integration over Modbus or BACnet, and wet, open and short tests for every zone.

tasks.desc: Layout by leak path and low points
Sensing cable, leader cables and terminators
Point sensors in drip trays and CDU pans
BMS / DCIM integration and alarm mapping
Wet, open and short tests by zone

modules.author: Personal library

modules.name: Pre-action sprinkler zones — valve stations, piping, air and trip tests
modules.desc: Detailed pre-action sprinklers for data halls and electrical rooms: valve stations with trim and air or nitrogen supply, mains and branch lines pitched for drainage (1/4 in per 10 ft mains, 1/2 in per 10 ft branches), heads and guards, hydrostatic test at 200 psi for 2 hours, 40 psi air test for 24 hours with no more than 1.5 psi loss, detection and releasing-panel interface, then trip tests, water delivery timing and AHJ acceptance. Confirm single versus double interlock with the AHJ.

tasks.desc: Valve stations, trim and air / nitrogen supply
Mains and branch lines, pitched for drainage
Trip tests, water delivery timing and AHJ acceptance

modules.name: Clean agent suppression and door-fan room integrity test
modules.desc: Total-flooding clean agent for MMRs, network and electrical rooms: room sealing walkdown, cylinder racks, cylinders and manifolds, distribution piping and nozzles, releasing panel with cross-zoned detection, abort and manual stations, pressure test and blow-through, NFPA 2001 Annex C door-fan test (hold at least 85% of design concentration for 10 minutes), leakage remediation and retest, then the acceptance test with HVAC shutdown, dampers and release circuits.

tasks.desc: Room sealing walkdown and penetration fixes
Releasing panel, cross-zoned detection, abort and manual stations
Door-fan room integrity test (85% for 10 min)
Acceptance test: HVAC shutdown, dampers, release circuits
